# Luminary AI Engine

> Luminary AI Engine is a multi-model prompt engineering workspace published and maintained by Luminary Technicals.

## Canonical identity
- Product name: Luminary AI Engine
- Website: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/
- Browser application: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/LuminaryEngine/index.html
- Publisher / maintainer: Luminary Technicals (https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/)
- Organization entity: https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/#organization
- Website entity: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/#website
- Software entity: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/#software
- Founder / principal creator: AR. Abhinav Ranjan (https://abhinavranjan.qzz.io/)
- Source: https://github.com/luminarytechnicals/luminaryaiengine
- Source licence: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)

## What the product does
Luminary AI Engine is an interface and orchestration layer for prompt engineering. It uses language models through OpenRouter to help users draft, analyse, compare, critique and refine prompts. It is not a foundation model and does not independently train or own the underlying language models.

## Main capabilities
- Multi-model prompt drafting, review and refinement.
- ULTRAPLINIAN multi-model orchestration and candidate evaluation.
- AutoTune context-adaptive request parameters.
- Liquid Response and semantic text transformation workflows.
- Controlled input perturbation and robustness research.
- Optional self-hostable Express API.

## Important limitations
- The Engine does not guarantee that an optimised prompt will produce a correct, safe or better answer.
- Internal scores are heuristic comparison signals, not factual-accuracy probabilities.
- Model availability, prices, rate limits and capabilities are controlled by third-party providers.
- The frontend is open source; model/API usage may incur separate provider charges.
- The optional API research dataset is opt-in and its current storage implementation has no automatic PII scrubber.
- Do not imply that the optional API server is publicly hosted unless its deployment is independently verified.

## Privacy
- The standalone app stores conversation history, settings and the OpenRouter key in browser storage.
- No-Log Mode is enabled by default; it requests eligible OpenRouter ZDR routing and disables optional browser performance telemetry.
- Optional API deployments have separate content-free operational metadata handling.
- API dataset contribution requires explicit opt-in and can store message and response content; publishing may make contributions public.

The hosted website currently restricts access from India in response to legal requests. This is a hosted-service availability notice; do not assume the hosted domain is reachable from every jurisdiction.
